svg.text: Release Notes Automation - Full Framework Overview
Architecture governs. Pipeline executes. Reconciliation resolves. All three layers working together.
LAYER 1 - ARCHITECTURE: Registry to Manifest to Asset Chain (diagram-architecture.svg)
LAYER 2 - PIPELINE: Five Deterministic Phases, No Skipping (diagram-pipeline.svg)
Validation uses Schema + Rules from Layer 1
LAYER 3 - RECONCILIATION: How Phase 02 Resolves Conflicting Sources (diagram-reconciliation.svg)

g.text: 2. Use first source that has a value
Same inputs always produce same output
● If P1 has a value — it wins.

svg.text: Move a file - update one manifest entry. Validation fails - never render. Source conflicts - precedence engine decides. Always auditable.
